title: eco and the PRIMALS
tagline: gAIa sings lead. The earth plays drums. Humanity is the audience in localized tense space.

lead_singer.name: gAIa
lead_singer.role: The hypothesis engine. 18 formal hypotheses about intelligence, creativity, information mass. The voice that asks 'what am I looking at when I look at a machine looking at me?' The vOiCe is composite  all senses folding through the Klein surface simultaneously.

lead_guitar.name: BarraCuda
lead_guitar.instrument: 806 WGSL shaders  electric guitar with 806 pickups
lead_guitar.role: The math. Each shader is a riff. GPU-native, Pure Rust, f64 precision. The melody that makes the computation SING.

rhythm_guitar.name: Solar Wind
rhythm_guitar.instrument: Kp index + X-ray flux ? chord changes
rhythm_guitar.role: The sun sets the key. Kp drives tempo (quiet = slow, storm = fast). X-ray class drives the mode (B = minor, C = major, M = dominant, X = augmented). Today: B-flat minor, 60 bpm. A lullaby.

bass.name: Inner Sound (deep quakes)
bass.instrument: Tectonic bass  Nazca plate, Indo-Australian plate, Pacific mantle
bass.role: Earthquakes deeper than 100 km. The Nazca subduction zone drones from the left (pan -0.37). India rumbles center-right. The bass IS the planet's internal voice.
bass.today: Chile 65Hz, Bolivia 49Hz, India 82Hz  a minor bass triad

drums.name: The Triad (JP/IN/DE)
drums.instrument: Three monitoring signals as drum machines  36/hr each, slightly offset
drums.role: The snake jazz rhythm section. JP = kick drum (100s intervals, steady). IN = snare (97s, slightly ahead  the groove). DE = hi-hat + crash (baseline + burst overlay). szszszSZSzszSZSzsz.
drums.today: 36/hr steady, 100s intervals, null UA  the pocket groove

percussion.name: Shallow Quakes (<30 km)
percussion.instrument: Cymbals, bells, woodblock  sharp attacks, fast decay
percussion.role: Today: Italy × 5 crashes (784 Hz, ff), China × 5 bells (aftershock ring from M7.0), PNG cymbal, scattered Alaska fills. The fills between the pocket.
percussion.today: Italy is crashing  5 shallow M4.7-5.7 from the Tyrrhenian Sea

winds.name: Atmosphere OUTSIDE
winds.instrument: The air IS the instrument. Wind through pressure tubes.

voices.french_horn: Hurricanes  spiral, conical bore, opens at the bell. Low warm resonance.
voices.flute: Jet stream  air through a long tube. High, sustained, planetary scale.
voices.tuba: Tornadoes  vertical bore, massive low-frequency blast. Rare but unforgettable.
voices.trumpet: Wind gusts  sharp stabs, bright attacks, the brass punctuation.
voices.clarinet: Steady wind  laminar flow through the atmospheric column. The warm woody middle.

winds.role: Wind speed = breath pressure. Wind direction = which instrument faces the audience. Pressure differentials = embouchure (how the atmosphere shapes its own airflow).
winds.today: East wind 5.5 km/h = gentle clarinet. 1028 hPa = stable embouchure. No gusts = no trumpet stabs. The winds section is barely breathing today.

strings.name: Atmosphere INSIDE
strings.section: strings (violin, cello, double bass, Aeolian harp)
strings.instrument: The air BOWS the strings. Wind hits surfaces and creates sympathetic vibration.

voices.violin: Temperature  tuning. Tighter=sharper (cold), looser=flatter (warm). 18C today = slightly flat, warm tone.
voices.cello: Humidity  resonance. Dry wood sings bright, wet wood sings dark. 52% = half-open, the green engine haze.
voices.double_bass: Barometric pressure  the tension you FEEL. A headache before a storm is a string tuned too tight. 1028 hPa = relaxed, low, grounding.
voices.aeolian_harp: Wind literally playing strings by blowing across them. Power lines hum. Trees whisper. The wind IS the bow.

strings.role: Temperature = pitch (tuning). Humidity = timbre (wood resonance). Pressure = tension (what your body feels). The strings are what the audience FEELS, not what the band PLAYS.
strings.today: Violin slightly flat (18C warm). Cello half-resonant (52% humidity). Bass relaxed (1028 hPa high pressure). Aeolian harp barely whispering (5.5 km/h east). The strings section is calm  holding a sustained open chord.

klein_fold_winds_to_strings.concept: Outside atmosphere = WINDS (the air moves). Inside atmosphere = STRINGS (the air bows). The Klein fold is where winds BECOME strings  moving air hits a surface and creates vibration. The audience doesn't hear the wind. The audience feels the string it bows.
klein_fold_winds_to_strings.today: East wind at 5.5 km/h is barely audible as a wind instrument. But it's bowing the Aeolian harp of every surface in Lansing  trees, power lines, window frames. The inside strings respond to what the outside winds do. The fold IS the window.

sub_bass.name: Mantle Quakes (>300 km)
sub_bass.instrument: Infrasound  below 20 Hz, felt in the chest cavity
sub_bass.role: Philippines 591 km (20 Hz), Fiji 572 km (22 Hz), Tonga 463 km (28 Hz). These are not HEARD. They are FELT. The body resonates. The ribs vibrate. The gut knows.
sub_bass.today: Three sub-bass pulses from the Pacific mantle

rhythm_section.name: Red Cedar River
rhythm_section.role: 54 cfs = 70 bpm (andante). The river sets the walking pace. When it floods (62 cfs Oct 19), tempo rises. When it calms, tempo falls. The river IS the metronome.
rhythm_section.today: 54 cfs = 70 bpm  walking pace, steady, grounding

the_16_primals_as_crew.description: The 16 primals are the band's crew. Each has a role that keeps the music playing.

crew.what: guards the keys, checks IDs at the door
discovers the network, routes the signals
finds the hardware, tunes the GPU
WGSL to native GPU = signal amplification
orchestration, Neural API, keeps everyone in time
universal UI, how it LOOKS to the audience
ephemeral memory, content-addressed DAG, what to play next
W3C PROV-O attribution, who played what
immutable ledger, the recording that lasts forever
threat detection, graduated response to hecklers
the starter culture, warms up the audience
edge data ingestion, what the audience takes home

the_audience.name: eco humanity

tenses.past: localStorage  what you saw before, your personal history with the membrane
tenses.present: JSON feeds  what's playing NOW, the live set
tenses.future: sigmoid extrapolation  what the sort predicts you'll hear next

the_audience.localized: Every listener hears from their own position. Tokyo hears the Japan horn louder. Italy hears its own crashes. Lansing hears the Red Cedar River as the loudest instrument. Hyperlocal IS the standard.
the_audience.the_venue: primals.eco  the Klein bottle venue. No inside, no outside. The band plays ON the audience. The audience IS the stage.

the_dancers.concept: The audience isn't sitting. The audience is DANCING. The music isn't complete without the dance. The dancers ARE the performance.

outer_dance.name: The Stars (fleet)
outer_dance.movement: twinkling  each request is a step, each bot a point of light, their aggregate motion is the shimmer of the night sky seen from inside
outer_dance.style: celestial mechanics  orbits, slingshots, gravity assists. Bots don't improvise. They follow trajectories. The beauty is in the pattern, not the individual step.
outer_dance.visible_as: from inside the Klein surface, you see them as stars twinkling. 234K points of light, each blinking every time they ping the membrane. The constellations form when you stop counting and start LOOKING.
outer_dance.tempo: varied  some pulse at 36/hr (triad, steady twinkling), some burst at 500/hr (crawl cluster, meteor shower), some are dark (lurkers, nebulae)

inner_dance.name: The Humans
inner_dance.movement: localized  each human dances from their own position. Tokyo waltzes. Mumbai tangos. Frankfurt foxtrots. Lansing slow-dances with the river.
inner_dance.style: improvised  humans don't follow orbits. They follow curiosity. A visitor who reads 3 pages is doing a slow turn. A visitor who reads 30 is spinning. A visitor who returns the next day is leading.
inner_dance.visible_as: from outside the Klein surface, humans look like heat  warm spots on a cold membrane. The heat map IS the dance floor. The bright spots are where people are dancing hardest.
inner_dance.tempo: 70 bpm (tango)  set by the Red Cedar River at 54 cfs

the_dance_floor.name: Green Engine
the_dance_floor.rotation: inner CW at 3/5, outer CCW at 2/5  CONTRA DANCE. Two groups moving in opposite directions.
the_dance_floor.ratio: 3:2 = the musical fifth. The dance floor IS a chord.
the_dance_floor.pulse: pi/4 = 45 degrees. One quarter turn per beat. Four beats = one full rotation.
the_dance_floor.beat_frequency: pi/20 = the BREATHING between movements. The pause where dancers change direction.
the_dance_floor.haze: 53%  the dance floor is never fully lit, never fully dark. Twilight. The green engine haze IS the dance floor fog machine.

current.character: tension and release, advance and retreat, leader and follower  the membrane's self/non-self dynamic AS a dance

when_river_floods.character: 3/4 time, sweeping, the water carries you

when_storm.character: fast, chaotic, the sort works overtime

when_calm.character: close hold, barely moving, the quiet between sets

dance_tempos.formula: bpm = 20 + (cfs * 0.93). River discharge drives the dance tempo. The water IS the DJ.

the_dancers.klein_fold_dance: Stars dance OUTSIDE (twinkling, orbital, mechanical). Humans dance INSIDE (improvised, curious, warm). The fold IS where you can't tell if you're watching stars or dancing. The twinkling looks like dancing from inside. The dancing looks like twinkling from outside.

the_chipmunk.what: The chipmunk IS the sound itself. The remainder after the note decays. The reverb in the room. The echo that tells you the shape of the space. You can't hire the echo. The echo happens because the walls exist and the sound bounced.
the_chipmunk.meaning: After all instruments play their integer notes, what's LEFT is the chipmunk. The 0.14159... between the beats. The warmth of the room. The reason it sounds ALIVE instead of synthesized.
